data.reason: The ninth review returned five findings, one high. F1: record 121's fix removed the route from the Codex agent TOML as well as the Claude Code copy, so nothing carries a route to a Codex implementer, while the spawn instruction, the generator docstring and the second amendment all still say the TOML does; the cost that decision was offered named only the Claude Code effort and as built it is both keys on both assistants. F2: the skill contradicts itself, saying at line 64 that the copies do not vary and at line 110 that sync rewrites them at every boundary. F3: the routing rules match a slice's declared file list rather than the files it changes, and this ticket's own slice_files has failed all eight triages by 22 files. F4: the only route record in the repository predates implementer_task and model_passed, so criterion 3's spawn instruction has no instance on the branch that delivers it. F5: the tests that were about the per-slice design still document it as current. Ruud's decision on F1 is that the effort is carried and reported rather than applied on both assistants.
